items.title: Buddy Burns and Frank Pasley Interview, 1968-09-23
items.q: I know that name, but I can't remember where the hell I know Walter at.

ctx.x: Call him, call him Chubby Hall.

Both of them did. Yeah, drummers. Only one, yeah, both of them drummers. But you don't know piano playing in Walter Hall. I don't, I can't remember. I know that name, but I can't remember where the hell I know Walter at. Yeah.
Because I know all the musicians.
